No master or doctorate field list is recorded: the scheme page's 'Degree Programs Offered' section lists only undergraduate (bachelor's) although its introduction and the overview page mention postgraduate and doctoral study; no page gives fields for those levels.
The Sri Lanka scheme's HEC subject list was checked: this scheme's pages do not link to it or say it applies, so it was NOT reused.
